answer.text:
The handbook doesn't say whether deals that come in through our partners count toward SDR quota.

This uncertainty is reflected in a support ticket from May 2026, where an SDR asked: "Do deals that come in through our partners count toward SDR quota? I couldn't find anything about this in the handbook or the quota doc. Just want to make sure before I log a few of these." No definitive answer was provided in the conversation, and no policy or FAQ currently addresses this question.

This information comes from a support ticket, not from documented policy. For a definitive answer, you should contact Sales Operations or Ecosystem Operations. Owner: @davemhayward (Ecosystem Operations) [ticket:4014#0].
